name: Surprise Takeaway
text: Each round, a random sigil is engraved on a random card in your hand.
timing: Always on, for you (at the deal)

signature.target: a random card in your hand

archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Swap Meet, Gold Miner
decision: How to bid and play around a new effect each round.
opponent: The borrowed sigil acts like any sigil and is shown when it triggers.
aiNote: Evaluate the borrowed sigil as if owned for the round.
rationale: A small lucky dip: a random Engraving sigil of any rarity is worth a few points on average and occasionally a rare lands, and it never fills a collection slot. It draws only sigils you don't own and lands on a card without a sigil.
deviation: Revision 1: draws from every Engraving sigil, not only commons you do not own.
